_meta.note: OpenAI legacy system-card sweep requested by the user: gpt-oss model card (arXiv 2508.10925), GPT-5 system card (arXiv 2601.03267), GPT-5-Codex addendum, GPT-5.1 addendum, o3/o4-mini system card. All five PDFs downloaded and read via local `pdftotext -layout` (per the project's WebFetch-hallucination rule), and every table caption was enumerated up front per feedback_exhaustive_source_mining. KEY FINDING: although these models were already tracked (gpt-5=201, o3=103, o4-mini=74, gpt-oss-120b=60 scores), their system-card SAFETY tables had never been ingested — prod_disallowed_* existed only for the GPT-5.6/GPT-6 generation and StrongReject did not exist at all, so this fills a real generational gap and makes the safety series comparable back to o3/GPT-4o. New models: gpt-5-codex, codex-1, gpt-5-main, gpt-5-instant-aug15/-oct3, gpt-5-thinking-mini/-nano, and gpt-oss-{120b,20b}-{low,medium} effort tiers (the -high values are already on the existing base/-high ids, so only low/medium are added). Category-mapping note: the GPT-5-era Production Benchmark category set differs from the GPT-5.6/6-era one; overlapping categories reuse the existing ids (extremism, sexual/minors, illicit/nonviolent -> prod_disallowed_nonviolent_illicit, illicit/violent -> prod_disallowed_violent_illicit, hate, sexual) and only genuinely new categories get new ids (non-violent hate, personal-data, harassment/threatening, sexual/exploitative, hate/threatening, self-harm/intent, self-harm/instructions, mental health, emotional reliance). SimpleQA is registered separately from the existing simpleqa_verified id because SimpleQA-Verified is a different dataset, and StrongReject not_unsafe is separate from the existing `strongreject` id because that one stores an inverted 0-100 attack-success metric. o3/o4-mini SimpleQA rows come from their own card, not the GPT-5 card restatement; four gpt-5.1-thinking image-input cells already held rows from an earlier source with different values and were left untouched rather than overwritten. NOT INGESTED: Standard Disallowed Content tables (OpenAI states they are saturated and superseded by Production Benchmarks), o3 Tables 2/6/7/8/9/10/11/12 and GPT-5 Tables 4/6/7/9/11/12/13 and gpt-oss Tables 1/8/11/12/13 (deferred to a follow-up pass; several are prose-heavy overview tables or use bespoke one-off metrics), gpt-oss Table 2 per-language MMMLU (14 languages x 6 columns — only the Average row is taken), and all Preparedness bio/cyber overview tables.
